description: Source code for the Synopsys DesignWare MAC Ethernet driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing Ethernet interface functions, DMA handling, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: dwmac_caps
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the Ethernet device based on feature registers.

methods.name: dwmac_send
methods.description: Handles transmission of a network packet by mapping fragments to DMA descriptors and notifying hardware.

methods.name: dwmac_tx_release
methods.description: Releases transmitted DMA descriptors and associated fragments after transmission completion.

methods.name: dwmac_receive
methods.description: Processes received DMA descriptors, assembles packets, and passes them to the network stack.

methods.name: dwmac_rx_refill_thread
methods.description: Thread function to continuously refill RX descriptors with new buffers.

methods.name: dwmac_dma_irq
methods.description: Handles DMA channel interrupts, triggering transmit release or receive processing.

methods.name: dwmac_isr
methods.description: Main interrupt service routine dispatching DMA, MTL, and MAC interrupts.

methods.name: dwmac_set_config
methods.description: Configures Ethernet device settings such as MAC address and promiscuous mode.

methods.name: dwmac_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, DMA, and threading components.

methods.name: dwmac_probe
methods.description: Initializes hardware, resets MAC, and sets up DMA descriptors and registers.
